thread:
sara (People Ops): Thanks for coming to today's all-hands. Dropping a live Q&A thread for leftover questions on promotions, comp timing, and the benefits note. Keep posts short — we'll follow up for any private cases.

mike (Eng): Two quick ones: 1) If a manager missed the calibration window by a day due to timezone travel, can it be accepted? 2) When do IC letters go out?

sara (People Ops): 1) Generally we need docs before freeze, but we make exceptions for travel if HRBP approves with timestamped evidence. DM Tess (HRBP) with context. 2) Manager letters target Friday EOD; IC letters Monday morning next week.

nora (IC): Is there a formal appeals window and what's it for?

sara (People Ops): Yes — 10 business days for factual appeals (typos, missing approvals, wrong job code). Not for re-arguing level outcomes. Appeal form goes live tomorrow at 9am.

devon (Manager): For someone who closed an improvement plan in July, are they promo-eligible this cycle? Need clarity for calibration.

tess (HRBP): If the PIP was closed and manager documents 3+ months of sustained performance prior to cutoff, they can be included. Attach the closure note to your submission.

mike (Eng): About salary bands — will there be a public summary of band shifts after the cycle? Managers see bands now?

sara (People Ops): Managers have band access for calibration. We'll publish an anonymized summary of band-level deltas after cycle close; individual comp remains private.

nora (IC): Any change to 401k match timing for mid-cycle hires? Heard a question during Q/A.

tess (HRBP): No change. Eligibility per plan docs (30 days). For missed matches, file a payroll ticket and cc people-ops so we can remediate.

devon (Manager): Can managers schedule calibration help? We have a few close calls.

sara (People Ops): Yes — office hours tomorrow 10–11:30 and Thursday 2–3. Book via Tess's calendar link (she'll post it).

notify-bot: :thinking_face: Town hall recording and slides: pinned in #general.

sara (People Ops): Thanks all — I'll update the thread when the appeal form and manager toolkit links are live. For private exceptions, DM your HRBP.
